base_member_text: [L19-L28] (HIGH/unchecked status / lifecycle) All return codes from initialization, parameter lookup, time stepping, and output are overwritten without validation, so failed initialization can leave t or tstop undefined and failed steps can still loop or emit output.
audit_member_text: [L14-L32] (HIGH/ignored lifecycle errors) Every return code after readinput is overwritten without inspection, so initialization, parameter lookup, step, output, or finalization failures cannot stop or alter the driver.
[L22-L24] (HIGH/undefined loop control) If either getdoubleparameter call fails, the ignored status leaves t or tstop potentially undefined before the main-loop comparison.
[L24-L29] (MED/nonprogress loop) The main loop has no guard that executestep successfully advances t, so a failed or zero-timestep step can run forever because its status is ignored.

adversarial.rationale: The ignored rc assignments exist, but the claimed inability of failures to stop the driver is false: init/final return zero on normal completion, and timestep failures are carried in libxbeach_module%error to outputext, which calls output_error and halts (libxbeach.F90:L228-L237). The fixed t/tstop lookups are valid generated parameters; no recoverable lifecycle failure bypassing this path was found.
